name: Jellyfin Upscaler
description: Enhance video quality with real-time upscaling for supported devices using AI models and advanced shader algorithms.
overview: The Jellyfin Upscaler Plugin provides intelligent video enhancement through AI upscaling (ESRGAN, Waifu2x) and traditional high-quality shaders (Bicubic, Lanczos). Features automatic content detection, device capability testing, and customizable enhancement profiles for optimal performance.
changelog: Initial release with AI upscaling support, client-side processing, intelligent content detection, and comprehensive device benchmarking.
